text: #910's independent review, before it merged. The check stages a draft in the language its caller names, whatever proposal.json says of its language or of code to check as it is, and the factory drops both from a draft before it gives it the issue's: a revision copied from an earlier proposal was checked as that proposal's language and built as the issue's. Only a bug that breaks a property stands with no replay path, told by what the bug's own run broke; a specification the path's check can't read was given the same code and stood, and is refused with the line to write. A refusal names every unprepared bug, with advice that fits its reason, and says when the reason is the check's own failure, such as TLC stalling, which no rewrite answers. The draft's view is read in the same check, since a draft has few checks. A bug whose definition names no operation the reader can call is told what the reader made of it. The prompt's example writes its bug as a named, guarded operation, the way a current bug has to be written, because a drafter writes what the example shows. Refines D-0475.
